scope: isolated temporary AI26 API and SQLite database; no user data or persistent service was modified
steps: Started the API on an isolated loopback port and passed GET /api/health.
Created an audited rules update and verified the audit chain before backup.
Created a SQLite online snapshot and confirmed mode 0600 and integrity_check=ok.
Made a second temporary rules update after the snapshot.
Stopped the API cleanly, restored the snapshot with explicit stopped-service confirmation, and restarted the API.
Confirmed the post-snapshot update was absent and the restored audit chain remained valid with one record.
limitations: This was a database-only restore drill; SQLite backup does not include footage, managed source releases, model weights, or JPEG evidence artifacts.
Authentication was disabled for the disposable test; this does not validate production account/MFA recovery or access controls.
No real incident, exposed secret, external checkpoint, TLS renewal, or off-host restore was simulated.
